messages.subject: outputOptions not finding output
parts:
I am trying to load all outputs on all tabs of my application using suspendWhenHidden...however I keep getting this error:

Warning: Error in .subset2(x, "impl")$outputOptions: finalreport is not in list of output objects
Stack trace (innermost first):
    42: .subset2(x, "impl")$outputOptions
    41: outputOptions
    40: server [/opt/shiny-server/samples/dev/welcome/server.R#321]
     1: shiny::runApp
Error in .subset2(x, "impl")$outputOptions(name, ...) : 
  finalreport is not in list of output objects

If I comment out "outputOptions(output,'finalreport',suspendWhenHidden=FALSE)" everything works.

Below is output$finalreport:

output$finalreport <- DT::renderDataTable({
      reportsubset <- classificationclientsubset[,list(ldv=sum(Date == date),lwv=sum(Date >= input$classificationdaterange[1] & Date <= input$classificationdaterange[2])),by=Category][,ldvP:=ldv/sum(ldv)][,lwvP:=lwv/sum(lwv)]                                              #group data by Category
      cols<-c("Category", "ldv","ldvP","lwv","lwvP")
      reportsubset<- as.data.frame(reportsubset[, .SD, .SDcols = cols])
      total<-c("Total", colSums(reportsubset[,2:5]))                                                  #create total row
      total[c(3,5)]<- ""                                                                              #remove percentages summation
      reportsubset<-rbind(reportsubset,total)                                                         #bind total row
      prevday<-format(date, format="%m/%d")                                                   #create column title for previous day
      prevweek<-paste0(format(input$classificationdaterange[1], format="%m/%d"),"-",format(input$classificationdaterange[2], format="%m/%d")) #create column title for previous week
      colnames(reportsubset) <- c("Category",prevday,"%",prevweek," %")                               #rename columns
      datatable(reportsubset,                                                                         #create dataTable using the finalDataset
                selection = list(target = 'cell'),
                rownames = FALSE, 
                options = list(order = list(list(2, 'desc')),
                  searching = FALSE,                                                                  #disable global search
                  lengthChange = FALSE,
                  autowidth = TRUE,                                                                   #autowidth the other columns
                  columnDefs = list(list(className = 'dt-center', targets = c(1,2,3,4))),
                  pageLength = 11,
                  lengthMenu = 11,
                  server = TRUE                                                                       #enable server side processing for better performance
                )) %>%  formatPercentage(c('%',' %'), 0) %>%  formatStyle("Category",fontWeight = 'bold',color=styleEqual(brks2,clrs2)) #add colors to the different Sources
    })

Obviously, finalreport is a valid output...why isn't it getting recognized?

Thanks,
Logan
